name: Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference Corpus (MultiNLI)
description: The Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MultiNLI) corpus is a crowd-sourced collection of 433k sentence pairs annotated with textual entailment information. Modeling both spoken and written genres of American English, MultiNLI spans ten distinct genres (fiction, letters, telephone, government, slate, facetoface, oup, oxford, travel, verbatim) to benchmark cross-genre generalization and sentence representation learning.
